'''Tears of Zylun''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] circling the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Shadda (star)|Shadda]] in the [[Shadda-Bi-Boran system]],<ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Toblain sector/Legends|Toblain sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The Tears of Zylun was situated between the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the system, [[Shadda-Bi-Boran/Legends|Shadda-Bi-Boran]], and the third, [[Chunno-ka-Alee]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Shadda-Bi-Boran system]], except [[Shadda-Bi-Boran/Legends|Shadda-Bi-Boran]], was introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
